name: Platinum Vape 510 Cartridge | Purple Punch
description: A knockout in both flavor and effect, Purple Punch blends sweet grape and blueberry notes with a creamy vanilla finish. This indica hits smooth and heavy, delivering a wave of full-body relaxation that pairs perfectly with its dessert-like taste. Expect calming euphoria that eases stress and melts you into the couch, making it a go-to for late nights or unwinding after a long day.
